description: Alias of search_packing_items — suggest gear for a trip by query + tripType/climate. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for United States users (English, USD, amazon.com /dp links); default amazon.se. Without marketplace/country, an en-US Accept-Language selects amazon.com.

country.description: Optional ISO country code of the end user, e.g. US → amazon.com, SE → amazon.se. Used when marketplace is omitted.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user: amazon.com (United States — English titles, USD prices, amazon.com /dp links) or amazon.se (Sweden, SEK). Also accepts ids like us / se. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US users. If omitted: country is used, then the caller's Accept-Language (en-US → amazon.com), else amazon.se. Unknown values fall back to amazon.se (never an error).

name: suggest_packing_items
title: Suggest packing items (alias)
